follow-up time: From 14-18 weeks of pregnancy to delivery
outcome: Pelvic floor muscle stiffness (levator ani, external anal sphincter)
cohort: Nulliparous women older than 18 years, with a normal pregnancy and a body mass index (BMI) lower than 35 kg.m(- 2)
finding: This study aims to investigate the changes in pelvic floor muscle stiffness during pregnancy and its association with perineal trauma at delivery in nulliparous women.
